name: Osmaura
long_description:
Osmaura help partners find and win new matters by monitoring the web, news, socials, and internal firm CRM to surface highly targeted opportunities for each partner.

As soon as a lawyer is made a partner, they’re expected to bring in new business.

However, it’s often not clear when a company is going to need legal counsel. So, partners are encouraged to do business development with every person in their network with the hope that at least one of them gives them work.

AI can give partners a deeper understanding of prospective clients and what kinds of legal support they might need at the right time.
one_liner: We find new matter opportunities for corporate law firms.
